ko.title: 쇠고기, 커피, 코코아: 일부 식료품 가격이 계속해서 기록을 경신하는 이유

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 전체 인플레이션은 정점 이후 진정되었지만, 최근 식료품 통로에 서본 사람이라면 누구나 헤드라인 수치가 전반적인 이야기를 다 말해주지 않는다는 것을 알고 있습니다.

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: **쇠고기, 커피, 초콜릿**을 포함한 소수의 일상 용품들은 끈질기게 비싼 상태를 유지했습니다.

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: 각각 저마다의 원인이 있으며, 안도감을 얻을 수 있는 전망도 다릅니다.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **참고:** 이 기사는 일반적인 배경 정보일 뿐, 재정적 또는 구매 조언이 아닙니다. 가격은 지역, 매장, 주(week)에 따라 다르므로 미국 노동통계국(U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics) 및 USDA 같은 공식 출처의 최신 수치를 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## 평균이 큰 차이를 숨길 수 있는 이유

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: 소비자물가지수는 수백 가지 상품을 혼합합니다.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: 에너지 비용이 완화되거나 중고차 가격이 하락할 때, 특정 식품이 계속 상승하는 동안에도 전체 수치를 끌어내릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: 식품은 또한 날씨, 동물 생물학, 작물 병해, 무역 정책 등 일반적인 경제 주기 외부에 있는 요인들에 유독 취약합니다.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 더 차분한 인플레이션 환경에서도 몇 가지 필수품이 계속해서 기록을 경신할 수 있는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## 쇠고기: 더 많은 소를 기르는 데는 수년이 걸립니다

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: 쇠고기 가격은 주로 **빠르게 재구축할 수 없는 공급**에 관한 이야기입니다.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **사육 두수.** 미국의 소 사육 두수는 수십 년 만에 최저 수준으로 줄어들었습니다. 주요 방목 지역에 걸친 수년간의 가뭄으로 인해 목초지와 건초가 부족하거나 비용이 많이 들었기 때문에 목축업자들은 가축을 조기에 처분해야 했습니다.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **생물학과 시기.** 떼를 늘리기 위해 남겨둔 암송아지는 도축에 사용할 수 없습니다. 그 후 송아지가 시장 출하 체중에 도달하는 데는 대략 2년 이상이 걸립니다. 따라서 재구축은 공급을 늘리기 전에 쇠고기 공급을 줄이게 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **유통 단계별 비용.** 사료, 연료, 노동 및 가공 비용은 모두 고기 진열대에 도달하는 것에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **무역.** 미국은 간 고기 제품에 사용되는 살코기 쇠고기를 상당량 수입합니다. 관세, 수입 제한, 공급업체 국가의 변화는 해당 부위의 비용을 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **가격 안정의 조짐이 보이나요?** 아마 곧는 아닐 것입니다.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 일반적으로 가축 떼가 재구축될 때까지 공급 부족이 지속될 것으로 예상하며, 그 과정은 수년이 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: 좋은 비와 저렴한 사료가 도움이 되겠지만, 시차는 소 사육 주기에 내재되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## 커피: 몇몇 지역의 날씨에 좌우되는 작물

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: 커피는 소수의 지역에서 재배되므로 한곳의 문제가 글로벌 시장 전체로 파급될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **기후 스트레스.** 브라질과 베트남 같은 주요 생산국의 가뭄, 폭염, 불규칙한 비는 일부 시즌의 수확량을 감소시켰습니다. 스페셜티 음료에 흔히 쓰이는 품종인 아라비카는 온도와 강수량에 특히 민감합니다.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **느린 재심기.** 새로운 커피나무가 수확물을 온전히 맺는 데는 수년이 걸리기 때문에 단일 시즌에 손실을 만회할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **운송 및 무역 비용.** 운송 차질, 환율 변동, 수입 관세가 로스터들이 지불하는 비용을 가중시킵니다.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **소매 시차.** 로스터들은 종종 미리 구매하고 헷징 계약을 사용하므로, 원자재 가격의 변화가 양방향으로 매대에 나타나는 데 몇 달이 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **가격 안정의 조짐이 보이나요?** 수확량에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: 핵심 국가들의 작황이 좋아지면 도매 가격을 낮출 수 있지만, 소매 가격은 올랐던 것보다 더 천천히 떨어지는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: 쇼핑객들은 더 낮은 라벨 가격을 보기 전에 더 많은 프로모션을 보게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## 코코아: 질병, 날씨, 그리고 집중된 공급

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: 초콜릿 가격은 식품 중 가장 집중된 공급망 중 하나를 반영합니다.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: 세계 코코아의 상당 부분이 서아프리카, 특히 코트디부아르와 가나에서 나옵니다.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **작물 문제.** 폭우, 건조기, 그리고 팽창 슛 바이러스 같은 식물 질병들이 최근 시즌의 수확량을 줄였습니다.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **노후화된 나무와 얇은 마진.** 많은 농장들이 오래된 나무를 가지고 있고 재심기 위한 자금이 제한되어 있어 생산을 억제하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **제품으로의 비용 전가.** 제조업체들은 더 높은 가격, 더 작은 포장 또는 레시피 변경으로 대응했습니다. 코코아는 설탕, 유제품, 포장재와 함께 하나의 성분일 뿐이기 때문에, 초콜릿 바에 미치는 영향은 지연되어 나타납니다.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **수요 반응.** 가격이 높은 상태를 유지하면 일부 구매자들은 더 저렴한 제품으로 바꾸거나 적게 사며, 이는 결국 시장의 압박을 완화할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **가격 안정의 조짐이 보이나요?** 코코아는 매 수확 보고서에 따라 급격하게 흔들릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: 서아프리카 생산량의 강한 회복이 도움이 되겠지만, 분석가들은 원료 코코아 가격이 하락한 후에도 소매 초콜릿 가격은 대개 천천히 조정된다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## 세 가지의 공통점

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | 항목 | 주요 압박 | 가격 안정화가 느린 이유 |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | 쇠고기 | 소 사육 두수 부족, 가뭄, 무역 비용 | 가축 떼 재구축에는 수년이 소요됨 |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | 커피 | 소수 핵심 지역의 날씨, 운송 | 새 나무가 생산하려면 수년이 필요함 |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | 코코아 | 질병, 날씨, 집중된 공급 | 소매 가격이 원자재에 비해 지연됨 |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: 각 경우에 문제의 핵심은 **느리게 반응하는 공급**이며, 여기에 빠르게 전가되고 천천히 철회되는 경향이 있는 비용이 결합되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 이를 종종 가격 경직성으로 설명합니다. 기업은 가격을 내리는 것보다 올리는 것이 더 빠릅니다.

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## 가계가 대처하는 실용적인 방법

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **부위 변경.** 간 고기, 목심 및 기타 저렴한 부위는 종종 스테이크보다 비용이 적게 들며, 저온 조리를 통해 부드럽게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **단백질 혼합.** 일부 식단에서 닭고기, 달걀, 콩류로 대체하면 주간 식비를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **커피 형태 비교.** 스토어 브랜드, 더 큰 봉지 또는 집에서 갈아 마시는 홀빈은 컵당 비용을 줄일 수 있습니다. 패키지 가격보다는 단위 가격을 주시하세요.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **프로모션 시 초콜릿 구매.** 시즌 세일과 스토어 브랜드는 절약을 제공할 수 있으며, 베이킹용 초콜릿은 일부 레시피를 대체할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **단위 가격 이용.** 줄어드는 패키지 크기는 가격이 변하지 않은 것처럼 보이게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: 전반적인 인플레이션이 진정된다고 해서 모든 가격이 함께 하락하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: 쇠고기, 커피, 코코아는 빠르게 해결할 수 없는 가축 떼, 수확량, 무역 비용에 의해 지탱되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: 가격 안정은 더 좋은 날씨, 더 많은 수확량, 재구축된 가축 떼를 통해 점진적으로 찾아올 가능성이 높으며, 원자재 시장보다 매장에 도달하는 시기가 아마 더 늦을 것입니다.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: 그때까지는 유연한 쇼핑 습관이 소비자가 가진 가장 신뢰할 수 있는 도구입니다.

zh.title: 牛肉、咖啡和可可：为什么一些日常杂货的价格不断创下新高

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 总体通胀率已从峰值回落，但最近去过杂货店的人都知道，总体数据并不能说明全部情况。

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: 少数日常用品，包括**牛肉、咖啡和巧克力**，价格依然居高不下。

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: 每种商品都有其自身的原因，缓解的前景也各不相同。

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **注意：** 本文仅供一般背景参考，不构成财务或购买建议。价格因地区、商店和周次而异，请查看美国劳工统计局 (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics) 和美国农业部 (USDA) 等官方来源的最新数据。

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## 为什么平均值会掩盖巨大的差异

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: 消费者价格指数涵盖了数百种商品。

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: 当能源成本下降或二手车价格下跌时，它们可以拉低整体数据，即使某些食品的价格仍在攀升。

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: 食品也异常容易受到正常经济周期之外因素的影响：天气、动物生物学、作物病害和贸易政策。

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么在通胀环境趋于平缓的情况下，一些主食价格仍能不断创下新高的原因。

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## 牛肉：增加牛群数量需要数年时间

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: 牛肉价格在很大程度上是一个关于**无法快速重建的供应**的故事。

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **牛群规模。** 美国的牛群规模已缩减至几十年来最低水平。主要放牧区连续几年的干旱迫使牧场主提前出售牲畜，因为牧场和干草稀缺或成本高昂。

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **生物学和时间。** 为扩大牛群而留下的母牛无法用于屠宰。此后，小牛长到市场重量大约需要两年或更长时间。因此，重建牛群在增加供应之前会先减少牛肉供应。

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **产业链成本。** 饲料、燃料、劳动力和加工成本都会影响肉类柜台最终的价格。

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **贸易。** 美国进口大量用于绞肉产品的瘦牛肉。关税、进口限制和供应国变动可能会提高这些肉块的成本。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **价格会缓解吗？** 可能不会很快。

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: 分析师普遍预计，在牛群重建之前，供应紧张的局面将持续存在，而这一过程可能需要数年时间。

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: 充足的雨水和更便宜的饲料会有所帮助，但滞后性是牛群周期中固有的。

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## 咖啡：少数几个地区的天气驱动型作物

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: 咖啡种植在少数几个地区，因此其中一个地区出现问题就可能波及全球市场。

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **气候压力。** 巴西和越南等主要生产国的干旱、高温和不规律降雨在某些季节减少了收成。阿拉比卡咖啡（Arabica）是特色饮品中常见的品种，对温度和降雨量特别敏感。

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **重新种植缓慢。** 一棵新的咖啡树需要几年时间才能结出完整的果实，因此损失无法在一个季节内修复。

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **运输和贸易成本。** 货运中断、汇率波动和进口关税增加了烘焙商的成本。

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **零售滞后。** 烘焙商通常会提前购买并使用对冲合约，因此商品价格的变化可能需要几个月的时间才能在货架上显现出来，无论是上涨还是下跌。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **价格会缓解吗？** 这取决于收成。

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: 关键国家的丰收可以降低批发价格，但零售价格的下跌速度往往比上涨速度慢。

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: 购物者在看到标价下降之前，可能会先看到更多的促销活动。

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## 可可：疾病、天气和集中的供应

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: 巧克力价格反映了食品行业中最集中的供应链之一。

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: 世界上大部分可可来自西非，特别是科特迪瓦和加纳。

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **作物问题。** 近几个季节，大雨、干旱和诸如肿枝病毒 (swollen shoot virus) 等植物病害导致产量下降。

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **树木老化和利润微薄。** 许多农场的树木较老，且缺乏重新种植的资金，这制约了生产。

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **向产品传导。** 制造商通过提高价格、缩小包装或改变配方来应对。由于可可是糖、乳制品和包装之外的单一成分，因此对糖果棒的影响会有所延迟。

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **需求反应。** 当价格保持高位时，一些买家会转向更便宜的替代品或减少购买，这最终可以缓解市场压力。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **价格会缓解吗？** 可可价格会随着每份收成报告而剧烈波动。

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: 西非产量的强劲复苏会有所帮助，但分析师提醒说，即使在原材料可可价格下跌后，零售巧克力价格通常也会缓慢调整。

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## 这三者的共同点

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | 商品 | 主要压力 | 缓解缓慢的原因 |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | 牛肉 | 牛群规模小、干旱、贸易成本 | 重建牛群需要数年 |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | 咖啡 | 少数关键地区的天气、运输 | 新树需要几年才能产出 |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | 可可 | 疾病、天气、供应集中 | 零售价格滞后于原材料商品 |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: 在每种情况下，问题都是**供应反应缓慢**，加上成本往往会迅速转嫁并缓慢回落。

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: 经济学家通常将其描述为价格粘性：企业提高价格的速度比降低价格的速度要快。

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## 家庭应对的实用方法

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **更换肉块。** 牛绞肉、牛肩肉和其他较便宜的肉块通常比牛排便宜，慢炖可以使它们变嫩。

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **混合蛋白质。** 在某些餐食中用鸡肉、鸡蛋、豆类或扁豆代替牛肉可以降低每周的开支。

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **比较咖啡形式。** 商店自有品牌、大包装或在家研磨的整豆可以降低每杯的成本。关注单位价格而不是包装价格。

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **在促销时购买巧克力。** 季节性销售和商店自有品牌可以节省开支，烘焙巧克力可以替代某些食谱中的巧克力。

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **使用单位价格。** 缩小的包装尺寸可能会让价格看起来没有变化，但实际上并非如此。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: 总体通胀降温并不意味着所有价格都会同时下跌。

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: 牛肉、咖啡和可可的价格受到牛群、收成和贸易成本的支撑，这些问题无法迅速解决。

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: 缓解最有可能通过更好的天气、更大的收成和重建的牛群逐渐到来，而且它到达商店货架的时间可能会晚于到达商品市场的时间。

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: 在此之前，灵活的购物习惯是消费者拥有的最可靠的工具。

hi.title: बीफ, कॉफी और कोको: कुछ किराने के सामान क्यों लगातार कीमत के रिकॉर्ड बना रहे हैं

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: समग्र मुद्रास्फीति अपने चरम से कम हो गई है, लेकिन हाल ही में किराने की aisle में खड़े हुए किसी भी व्यक्ति को पता है कि मुख्य आंकड़ा पूरी कहानी नहीं बताता है।

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: रोजमर्रा की कुछ चीजें, जिनमें **बीफ, कॉफी और चॉकलेट** शामिल हैं, जिद्दी रूप से महंगी बनी हुई हैं।

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक का अपना कारण है, और प्रत्येक के लिए राहत का दृष्टिकोण अलग है।

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **Note:** यह लेख सामान्य पृष्ठभूमि है, वित्तीय या खरीदारी की सलाह नहीं है। कीमतें क्षेत्र, स्टोर और सप्ताह के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं, इसलिए अमेरिकी श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics) और USDA जैसे आधिकारिक स्रोतों से वर्तमान आंकड़े देखें।

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## औसत बड़े अंतर को क्यों छिपा सकते हैं

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक सैकड़ों वस्तुओं का मिश्रण करते हैं।

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: जब ऊर्जा की लागत कम होती है या इस्तेमाल की गई कारों की कीमतें गिरती हैं, तो वे समग्र आंकड़े को नीचे खींच सकती हैं, भले ही कुछ खाद्य पदार्थों की कीमतें लगातार बढ़ रही हों।

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: खाद्य पदार्थ उन चीज़ों के प्रति भी असामान्य रूप से संवेदनशील होते हैं जो सामान्य आर्थिक चक्रों से बाहर बैठती हैं: मौसम, पशु जीवविज्ञान, फसल रोग और व्यापार नीति।

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि शांत मुद्रास्फीति के माहौल में भी कुछ मुख्य वस्तुएं रिकॉर्ड बनाना जारी रख सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## बीफ: अधिक मवेशी तैयार करने में वर्षों लगते हैं

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: बीफ की कीमतें मुख्य रूप से **ऐसी आपूर्ति** के बारे में हैं **जिसे जल्दी से फिर से नहीं बनाया जा सकता है**।

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **Herd size.** अमेरिका का मवेशी झुंड दशकों में अपने सबसे निचले स्तर पर सिकुड़ गया है। प्रमुख चरागाह क्षेत्रों में कई वर्षों के सूखे ने rancher को अपने जानवरों को जल्दी बेचने के लिए मजबूर किया क्योंकि चारा और घास दुर्लभ या महंगे थे।

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **Biology and timing.** झुंड को बढ़ाने के लिए रोकी गई बछिया वध के लिए उपलब्ध नहीं है। इसके बाद उसके बछड़े के बाजार के वजन तक पहुँचने में लगभग दो साल या उससे अधिक का समय लगता है। इसलिए झुंड को फिर से बनाने से बीफ की आपूर्ति बढ़ाने से पहले कम हो जाती है।

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **Costs along the chain.** चारा, ईंधन, श्रम और प्रसंस्करण लागत सभी इस बात को प्रभावित करते हैं कि मांस के काउंटर में क्या समाप्त होता है।

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **Trade.** अमेरिका पिसे हुए उत्पादों में उपयोग किए जाने वाले दुबले बीफ की एक सार्थक मात्रा का आयात करता है। टैरिफ, आयात सीमा और आपूर्तिकर्ता देशों में बदलाव उन कटों के लिए लागत बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **Is relief in sight?** शायद जल्द ही नहीं।

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक आम तौर पर उम्मीद करते हैं कि झुंड के फिर से बनने तक तंग आपूर्ति बनी रहेगी, और वह प्रक्रिया वर्षों ले सकती है।

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: अच्छी बारिश और सस्ते चारे से मदद मिलेगी, लेकिन मवेशी चक्र में अंतराल अंतर्निहित है।

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## कॉफी: कुछ स्थानों पर मौसम से संचालित फसल

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: कॉफी थोड़े से क्षेत्रों में उगाई जाती है, इसलिए एक में परेशानी वैश्विक बाजार में लहर पैदा कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **Climate stress.** ब्राजील और वियतनाम जैसे प्रमुख उत्पादकों में सूखा, गर्मी और अनियमित बारिश ने कुछ मौसमों में फसल को कम कर दिया है। अरेबिका, जो विशेष पेय पदार्थों में आम किस्म है, तापमान और वर्षा के प्रति विशेष रूप से संवेदनशील है।

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **Slow replanting.** एक नए कॉफी के पेड़ को पूरी फसल देने में कई साल लगते हैं, इसलिए नुकसान को एक ही सीजन में ठीक नहीं किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **Shipping and trade costs.** माल ढुलाई में व्यवधान, मुद्रा में उतार-चढ़ाव और आयात शुल्क रोस्टर जो भुगतान करते हैं उसमें जोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Retail lag.** रोस्टर अक्सर आगे खरीदते हैं और हेजिंग अनुबंधों का उपयोग करते हैं, इसलिए कमोडिटी की कीमत में बदलाव अलमारियों पर दिखने में महीनों लग सकते हैं, दोनों दिशाओं में।

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **Is relief in sight?** यह फसलों पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: प्रमुख देशों में बड़ी फसलें थोक कीमतों को नीचे ला सकती हैं, लेकिन खुदरा कीमतें बढ़ने की तुलना में अधिक धीरे-धीरे गिरने की प्रवृत्ति रखती हैं।

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: खरीदार कम स्टिकर मूल्य देखने से पहले अधिक प्रचार देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## कोको: बीमारी, मौसम और केंद्रित आपूर्ति

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: चॉकलेट की कीमतें भोजन में सबसे केंद्रित आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं में से एक को दर्शाती हैं।

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: दुनिया के कोको का एक बड़ा हिस्सा पश्चिम अफ्रीका से आता है, विशेष रूप से आइवरी कोस्ट और घाना।

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Crop problems.** भारी बारिश, सूखे के दौर और सूजन शूट वायरस जैसी पौधों की बीमारियों ने हाल के सत्रों में पैदावार को कम कर दिया है।

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** कई खेतों में पुराने पेड़ हैं और फिर से लगाने के लिए सीमित पैसा है, जो उत्पादन को रोके रखता है।

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Pass-through to products.** निर्माताओं ने उच्च कीमतों, छोटेपैकेज या नुस्खे में बदलाव के साथ जवाब दिया है। चूँकि कोको चीनी, डेयरी और पैकेजिंग के साथ केवल एक घटक है, इसलिए कैंडी बार पर प्रभाव देरी से दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Demand response.** जब कीमतें उच्च रहती हैं, तो कुछ खरीदार नीचे व्यापार करते हैं या कम खरीदते हैं, जो अंततः बाजार पर दबाव को कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **Is relief in sight?** कोको प्रत्येक फसल रिपोर्ट के साथ तेजी से उतार-चढ़ाव कर सकता है।

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: पश्चिम अफ्रीकी उत्पादन में एक मजबूत सुधार से मदद मिलेगी, लेकिन विश्लेषकों का चेतावनी है कि कच्चे कोको के गिरने के बाद भी खुदरा चॉकलेट की कीमतें आम तौर पर धीरे-धीरे समायोजित होती हैं।

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## तीनों में क्या समानता है

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |

segments.tr: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक मामले में, समस्या **आपूर्ति है जो धीरे-धीरे प्रतिक्रिया करती है**, उन लागतों के साथ संयुक्त है जो जल्दी से पारित हो जाती हैं और धीरे-धीरे वापस लुढ़क जाती हैं।

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री अक्सर इसे मूल्य चिपचिपाहट के रूप में वर्णन करते हैं: कंपनियां कीमतों में कटौती करने की तुलना में कीमतें बढ़ाने में तेज होती हैं।

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## व्यावहारिक तरीके जिनसे परिवार मुकाबला करते हैं

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **Shift cuts.** ग्राउंड बीफ, चक और अन्य कम महंगे कट अक्सर स्टीक्स से कम खर्च करते हैं, और धीमी गति से खाना पकाने से वे कोमल हो जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **Mix proteins.** कुछ भोजन में चिकन, अंडे, बीन्स या दाल को प्रतिस्थापित करने से साप्ताहिक बिल कम हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **Compare coffee formats.** स्टोर ब्रांड, बड़े बैग या घर पर पिसी हुई साबुत बीन्स प्रति कप लागत को कम कर सकती हैं। पैकेज की कीमत के बजाय इकाई मूल्य देखें।

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** मौसमी बिक्री और स्टोर ब्रांड बचत की पेशकश कर सकते हैं, और बेकिंग चॉकलेट कुछ व्यंजनों को प्रतिस्थापित कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **Use unit prices.** पैकेज के सिकुड़ते आकार कीमत को अपरिवर्तित दिखा सकते हैं जब ऐसा नहीं होता है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: शीतलक समग्र मुद्रास्फीति का मतलब यह नहीं है कि हर कीमत एक साथ गिरती है।

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: बीफ, कॉफी और कोको झुंड, फसल और व्यापार लागत द्वारा आयोजित किए जाते हैं जिन्हें जल्दी से ठीक नहीं किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: राहत बेहतर मौसम, बड़ी फसलों और पुनर्निर्माण झुंडों के माध्यम से क्रमिक रूप से आने की सबसे अधिक संभावना है, और यह संभवतः कमोडिटी बाजारों तक पहुंचने की तुलना में बाद में स्टोर की अलमारियों तक पहुंचेगी।

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: तब तक, लचीली खरीदारी की आदतें उपभोक्ताओं के पास सबसे विश्वसनीय उपकरण हैं।

es.title: Carne de vacuno, café y cacao: por qué algunos productos básicos de la cesta de la compra siguen marcando precios récord

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: La inflación general se ha enfriado desde su punto máximo, pero cualquiera que haya estado recientemente en el pasillo de un supermercado sabe que la cifra principal no cuenta toda la historia.

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: Un puñado de artículos de uso diario, incluidos la **carne de vacuno, el café y el chocolate**, se han mantenido persistentemente caros.

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: Cada uno tiene su propia causa, y cada uno tiene una perspectiva diferente de alivio.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **Nota:** Este artículo es información general de fondo, no un consejo financiero o de compra. Los precios varían según la región, la tienda y la semana, por lo que se recomienda consultar las cifras actuales de fuentes oficiales como la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales de EE. UU. y el USDA.

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## Por qué los promedios pueden ocultar grandes diferencias

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: Los índices de precios al consumo combinan cientos de bienes.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: Cuando los costes de la energía se moderan o los precios de los coches de segunda mano bajan, pueden hacer bajar la cifra general aunque ciertos alimentos sigan subiendo.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: Los alimentos también están inusualmente expuestos a factores que quedan fuera de los ciclos económicos normales: el clima, la biología animal, las enfermedades de los cultivos y la política comercial.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: Es por eso que unos pocos productos básicos pueden seguir marcando récords en un entorno de inflación más tranquila.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## Carne de vacuno: se tardan años en criar más ganado

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: Los precios de la carne de vacuno son en gran medida una historia sobre una **oferta que no se puede reconstruir rápidamente**.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **Tamaño del rebaño.** El rebaño de ganado de EE. UU. se ha reducido a algunos de sus niveles más bajos en décadas. Varios años de sequía en las principales regiones de pastoreo empujaron a los ganaderos a vender animales antes de tiempo porque los pastos y el heno eran escasos o caros.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **Biología y tiempos.** Una vaquillona que se retiene para reconstruir el rebaño no está disponible para el sacrificio. Además, pasan aproximadamente dos años o más antes de que su ternero alcance el peso de mercado. Por lo tanto, la reconstrucción reduce la oferta de carne de vacuno antes de aumentarla.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **Costes a lo largo de la cadena.** Los costes de alimentación, combustible, mano de obra y procesamiento afectan a lo que termina en el mostrador de la carne.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **Comercio.** EE. UU. importa una cantidad significativa de carne de vacuno magra utilizada en productos molidos. Los aranceles, los límites de importación y los cambios en los países proveedores pueden aumentar los costes de esos cortes.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **¿Hay alivio a la vista?** Probablemente no pronto.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: Los analistas generalmente esperan que la escasez de oferta persista hasta que los rebaños se reconstruyan, y ese proceso puede llevar años.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: Buenas lluvias y un pienso más barato ayudarían, pero el retraso está integrado en el ciclo ganadero.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## Café: un cultivo impulsado por el clima en unos pocos lugares

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: El café se cultiva en un número reducido de regiones, por lo que los problemas en una pueden repercutir en todo el mercado global.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **Estrés climático.** Las sequías, el calor y las lluvias irregulares en importantes productores como Brasil y Vietnam han reducido las cosechas en algunas temporadas. El arábica, la variedad común en bebidas especializadas, es especialmente sensible a la temperatura y las precipitaciones.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **Replantación lenta.** Un nuevo cafeto tarda varios años en dar una cosecha completa, por lo que las pérdidas no se pueden solucionar en una sola temporada.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **Costes de envío y comercio.** Las interrupciones en el transporte de mercancías, las oscilaciones divisarias y los aranceles de importación se suman a lo que pagan los tostadores.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Retraso en la venta minorista.** Los tostadores a menudo compran con antelación y utilizan contratos de cobertura, por lo que los cambios en el precio de la materia prima pueden tardar meses en verse en los estantes, en ambas direcciones.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **¿Hay alivio a la vista?** Depende de las cosechas.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: Cosechas más grandes en países clave pueden hacer bajar los precios al por mayor, pero los precios minoristas tienden a bajar más lentamente de lo que subieron.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: Es posible que los compradores vean más promociones antes de ver precios de etiqueta más bajos.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## Cacao: enfermedades, clima y oferta concentrada

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: Los precios del chocolate reflejan una de las cadenas de suministro más concentradas en la alimentación.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: Una gran parte del cacao mundial procede de África Occidental, especialmente de Costa de Marfil y Ghana.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Problemas en los cultivos.** Las fuertes lluvias, los periodos de sequía y las enfermedades de las plantas, como el virus del brote hinchado, han reducido los rendimientos en las últimas temporadas.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **Árboles envejecidos y escasos márgenes.** Muchas explotaciones tienen árboles más viejos y fondos limitados para la replantación, lo que frena la producción.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Traslado a los productos.** Los fabricantes han respondido con precios más altos, envases más pequeños o cambios en las recetas. Dado que el cacao es solo un ingrediente junto con el azúcar, los lácteos y el embalaje, el efecto en una barra de caramelo se muestra con retraso.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Respuesta de la demanda.** Cuando los precios se mantienen altos, algunos compradores cambian a opciones más baratas o compran menos, lo que eventualmente puede aliviar la presión sobre el mercado.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **¿Hay alivio a la vista?** El cacao puede oscilar bruscamente con cada informe de cosecha.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: Una fuerte recuperación de la producción en África Occidental ayudaría, pero los analistas advierten que los precios minoristas del chocolate suelen ajustarse lentamente incluso después de que baje el cacao en grano.

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## Qué tienen en común los tres

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | Artículo | Presión principal | Por qué el alivio es lento |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | Carne de vacuno | Rebaño reducido, sequía, costes comerciales | Reconstruir los rebaños lleva años |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | Café | Clima en unas pocas regiones clave, transporte | Los árboles nuevos necesitan años para producir |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: En cada caso, el problema es una **oferta que responde lentamente**, combinada con costes que tienden a trasladarse rápidamente y a reducirse con lentitud.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: Los economistas a menudo describen esto como rigidez de precios: las empresas son más rápidas para subir los precios que para bajarlos.

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## Formas prácticas en que los hogares hacen frente

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **Cambiar de cortes.** La carne picada, la aguja y otros cortes menos caros suelen costar menos que los chuletones, y la cocción lenta los vuelve tiernos.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **Mezclar proteínas.** Sustituir la carne por pollo, huevos, alubias o lentejas en algunas comidas puede reducir la factura semanal.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **Comparar formatos de café.** Las marcas de distribuidor, las bolsas más grandes o el café en grano molido en casa pueden reducir el coste por taza. Fíjese en el precio unitario en lugar de en el precio del paquete.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **Comprar chocolate en oferta.** Las rebajas de temporada y las marcas de distribuidor pueden ofrecer ahorros, y el chocolate para repostería puede sustituirse en algunas recetas.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **Usar los precios unitarios.** La reducción del tamaño de los envases puede hacer que un precio parezca no haber cambiado cuando no es así.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: Que la inflación general se enfríe no significa que todos los precios bajen a la vez.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: La carne de vacuno, el café y el cacao están frenados por rebaños, cosechas y costes comerciales que no se pueden solucionar rápidamente.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: Es más probable que el alivio llegue de forma gradual, a través de un mejor clima, cosechas más abundantes y rebaños reconstruidos, y probablemente llegará a los estantes de las tiendas más tarde que a los mercados de materias primas.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: Hasta entonces, los hábitos de compra flexibles son la herramienta más fiable que tienen los consumidores.

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## لماذا يمكن للمتوسطات أن تخفي فروقًا كبيرة

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: تدمج مؤشرات أسعار المستهلك مئات البضائع.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: عندما تنخفض تكاليف الطاقة أو تنخفض أسعار السيارات المستعملة، يمكنها سحب الرقم الإجمالي إلى الأسفل حتى بينما تستمر بعض الأطعمة في الارتفاع.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: الغذاء أيضًا معرض بشكل غير عادي لأشياء تقع خارج الدورات الاقتصادية العادية: الطقس، والبيولوجيا الحيوانية، وأمراض المحاصيل، والسياسة التجارية.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب يمكن لعدد قليل من السلع الأساسية الاستمرار في تسجيل أرقام قياسية في بيئة تضخم أكثر هدوءًا.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## لحم البقر: يستغرق الأمر سنوات لتربية المزيد من الماشية

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: أسعار لحوم البقر هي إلى حد كبير قصة عن **العرض الذي لا يمكن إعادة بنائه بسرعة**.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **حجم القطيع.** تقلص قطيع الماشية الأمريكي إلى أدنى مستوياته منذ عقود. دفعت عدة سنوات من الجفاف عبر مناطق الرعي الرئيسية المزارعين إلى بيع الحيوانات مبكرًا لأن المراعي والقش كانا نادرين أو مكلفين.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **البيولوجيا والتوقيت.** العجلة التي يتم الاحتفاظ بها لبناء القطيع ليست متاحة للذبح. ثم يستغرق الأمر حوالي عامين أو أكثر قبل أن يصل عجولها إلى وزن السوق. لذلك، فإن إعادة البناء تقلل من إمدادات لحوم البقر قبل أن تزيدها.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **التكاليف عبر السلسلة.** تؤثر تكاليف العلف والوقود والعمالة والمعالجة على ما ينتهي به المطاف في حافظة اللحوم.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **التجارة.** تستورد الولايات المتحدة كمية كبيرة من لحم البقر الخالي من الدهون المستخدم في المنتجات المفرومة. يمكن أن ترفع التعرفة الجمركية وقيود الاستيراد والتحولات في البلدان الموردة التكاليف لهذه القطع.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **هل هناك فرج في الأفق؟** ربما ليس قريبًا.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: يتوقع المحللون عمومًا استمرار شح الإمدادات حتى يتم إعادة بناء القطعان، وتلك العملية قد تستغرق سنوات.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: الأمطار الجيدة والأعلاف الأرخص ستساعد، لكن التأخير جزء لا يتجزأ من دورة الماشية.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## القهوة: محصول يعتمد على الطقس في أماكن قليلة

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: تزرع القهوة في عدد صغير من المناطق، لذا فإن المشاكل في منطقة واحدة يمكن أن تؤثر على السوق العالمية بأكملها.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **الإجهاد المناخي.** أدت حالات الجفاف والحرارة والأمطار غير المنتظمة لدى كبار المنتجين مثل البرازيل وفيتنام إلى تقليل المحاصيل في بعض المواسم. الأرابيكا، وهي السلالة الشائعة في المشروبات المختصة، حساسة بشكل خاص لدرجات الحرارة وهطول الأمطار.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **بطء إعادة الزراعة.** تستغرق شجرة القهوة الجديدة عدة سنوات لإعطاء محصول كامل، لذا لا يمكن إصلاح الخسائر في موسم واحد.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **تكاليف الشحن والتجارة.** تزيد اضطرابات الشحن وتقلبات العملات والرسوم الجمركية على الاستيراد مما يدفعه المحمصون.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **التأخير في تجارة التجزئة.** غالبًا ما يشتري المحمصون مسبقًا ويستخدمون عقود التحوط، لذا فإن التغييرات في سعر السلعة قد تستغرق أشهرًا لتظهر على الرفوف، في كلا الاتجاهين.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **هل هناك فرج في الأفق؟** يعتمد ذلك على المحاصيل.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: يمكن للمحاصيل الأكبر في البلدان الرئيسية أن تخفض أسعار الجملة، لكن أسعار التجزئة تميل إلى انخفاض أبطأ مما ارتفعت به.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: قد يرى المتسوقون المزيد من العروض الترويجية قبل أن يرى أسعارًا مدونة أقل.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## الكاكاو: الأمراض والطقس والعرض المركز

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: تعكس أسعار الشوكولاتة واحدة من أكثر سلاسل التوريد تركيزاً في قطاع الأغذية.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: تأتي حصة كبيرة من كاكاو العالم من غرب أفريقيا، وتحديداً من ساحل العاج وغانا.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **مشاكل المحاصيل.** أدت الأمطار الغزيرة، وفترات الجفاف، وأمراض النباتات مثل فيروس تورم البراعم إلى خفض الإنتاج في المواسم الأخيرة.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **تقادم الأشجار وهوامش الربح الضئيلة.** تمتلك العديد من المزارع أشجاراً قديمة وأموالاً محدودة لإعادة الزراعة، مما يعيق الإنتاج.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **انتقال التكلفة إلى المنتجات.** استجاب المصنعون بأسعار أعلى، أو عبوات أصغر، أو تغييرات في الوصفات. ولأن الكاكاو مجرد مكون واحد إلى جانب السكر ومنتجات الألبان والتغليف، فإن التأثير على لوح الشوكولاتة يظهر بتأخير.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **استجابة الطلب.** عندما تظل الأسعار مرتفعة، يلجأ بعض المشترين إلى بدائل أرخص أو يشترون كميات أقل، وهو ما قد يخفف الضغط على السوق في نهاية المطاف.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **هل هناك أمل في تحسن الوضع؟** يمكن أن تتأرجح أسعار الكاكاو بشكل حاد مع كل تقرير حصاد.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: إن التعافي القوي في إنتاج غرب أفريقيا سيساعد، لكن المحللين يحذرون من أن أسعار الشوكولاتة بالتجزئة تتعدل عادة ببطء حتى بعد انخفاض أسعار الكاكاو الخام.

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## ما المشترك بين الثلاثة

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | السلعة | الضغط الرئيسي | لماذا يكون التحسن بطيئاً |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | لحم البقر | قطيع ماشية صغير، جفاف، تكاليف التجارة | إعادة بناء القطعان تستغرق سنوات |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | القهوة | الطقس في بضع مناطق رئيسية، الشحن | الأشجار الجديدة تحتاج سنوات للإنتاج |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | الكاكاو | الأمراض، الطقس، تركيز التوريد | أسعار التجزئة تتأخر عن السلعة الخام |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: في كل حالة، تكمن المشكلة في **العرض الذي يستجيب ببطء**، إلى جانب التكاليف التي تميل إلى الانتقال بسرعة وتتراجع ببطء.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يصف الاقتصاديون هذا بـ "جمود الأسعار": الشركات أسرع في رفع الأسعار منها في خفضها.

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## طرق عملية تتكيف بها الأسر

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **تغيير قطع اللحم.** غالباً ما يكون اللحم المفروم، وقطع الكتف، وغيرها من القطع الأقل تكلفة أرخص من شرائح اللحم (ستيك)، كما أن الطهي البطيء يجعلها طرية.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **تنويع البروتينات.** استبدال الدجاج أو البيض أو الفاصوليا أو العدس في بعض الوجبات يمكن أن يقلل الفاتورة الأسبوعية.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **مقارنة أنواع القهوة.** العلامات التجارية الخاصة بالمتاجر، أو الأكياس الأكبر حجماً، أو الحبوب الكاملة التي تُطحن في المنزل يمكن أن تقلل التكلفة لكل كوب. راقب سعر الوحدة بدلاً من سعر العبوة.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **شراء الشوكولاتة أثناء العروض.** يمكن أن توفر التخفيضات الموسمية والعلامات التجارية الخاصة بالمتاجر وفورات، كما يمكن استخدام شوكولاتة الخبز كبديل في بعض الوصفات.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **استخدام أسعار الوحدة.** يمكن أن يؤدي تقليص أحجام العبوات إلى جعل السعر يبدو ثابتاً بينما هو ليس كذلك.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: تباطؤ التضخم العام لا يعني أن كل الأسعار تنخفض معاً.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: لحم البقر والقهوة والكاكاو تظل أسعارها مرتفعة بسبب القطعان والمحاصيل وتكاليف التجارة التي لا يمكن إصلاحها بسرعة.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: من المرجح أن يأتي التحسن تدريجياً، من خلال طقس أفضل ومحاصيل أكبر وقطعان مُعاد بناؤها، ومن المحتمل أن يصل إلى أرفف المتاجر في وقت لاحق لوصوله إلى أسواق السلع الأساسية.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: حتى ذلك الحين، تظل عادات التسوق المرنة هي الأداة الأكثر موثوقية التي يمتلكها المستهلكون.

fr.title: Bœuf, café et cacao : pourquoi certains produits de base continuent de battre des records de prix

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: L'inflation globale a ralenti par rapport à son pic, mais quiconque a fait ses courses dans une allée de supermarché récemment sait que le chiffre global ne dit pas toute la vérité.

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: Une poignée d'articles du quotidien, notamment **le bœuf, le café et le chocolat**, sont restés obstinément chers.

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: Chacun a sa propre cause, et chacun a des perspectives de soulagement différentes.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **Remarque :** Cet article est un contexte général, et non un conseil financier ou d'achat. Les prix varient selon la région, le magasin et la semaine, veuillez donc vérifier les chiffres actuels auprès de sources officielles telles que le U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics et l'USDA.

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les moyennes peuvent masquer de grandes différences

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: Les indices des prix à la consommation regroupent des centaines de biens.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: Lorsque les coûts de l'énergie baissent ou que les prix des voitures d'occasion chutent, ils peuvent faire baisser le chiffre global même si certains aliments continuent d'augmenter.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: L'alimentation est également exceptionnellement exposée à des facteurs qui se situent en dehors des cycles économiques normaux : la météo, la biologie animale, les maladies des cultures et la politique commerciale.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi quelques produits de base continuent de battre des records dans un environnement d'inflation plus calme.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## Bœuf : il faut des années pour produire plus de bétail

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: Les prix du bœuf s'expliquent en grande partie par **une offre qui ne peut pas être reconstituée rapidement**.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **Taille du cheptel.** Le cheptel bovin américain a chuté à des niveaux parmi les plus bas depuis des décennies. Plusieurs années de sécheresse dans les principales régions de pâturage ont poussé les éleveurs à vendre leurs animaux plus tôt car les pâturages et le foin étaient rares ou coûteux.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **Biologie et timing.** Une génisse conservée pour reconstituer le cheptel n'est pas disponible pour l'abattage. Il faut ensuite environ deux ans ou plus pour que son veau atteigne le poids du marché. La reconstitution réduit donc l'offre de bœuf avant de l'augmenter.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **Coûts tout au long de la chaîne.** Les coûts des aliments pour animaux, du carburant, de la main-d'œuvre et de la transformation affectent tous ce qui se retrouve au rayon boucherie.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **Commerce.** Les États-Unis importent une quantité importante de bœuf maigre utilisé dans les produits hachés. Les droits de douane, les limites d'importation et les changements de pays fournisseurs peuvent faire augmenter les coûts de ces morceaux.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **Un répit est-il en vue ?** Probablement pas de sitôt.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: Les analystes s'attendent généralement à ce que les approvisionnements restent tendus jusqu'à la reconstitution des cheptels, et ce processus peut prendre des années.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: De bonnes pluies et des aliments pour animaux moins chers aideraient, mais le décalage est inhérent au cycle du bétail.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## Café : une culture dépendante de la météo dans quelques endroits

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: Le café est cultivé dans un petit nombre de régions, de sorte que les difficultés dans l'une d'elles peuvent se répercuter sur le marché mondial.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **Stress climatique.** Les sécheresses, la chaleur et les pluies irrégulières dans les principaux pays producteurs comme le Brésil et le Viêt Nam ont réduit les récoltes au cours de certaines saisons. L'arabica, la variété courante dans les boissons de spécialité, est particulièrement sensible à la température et aux précipitations.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **Replantation lente.** Un nouveau caféier met plusieurs années à donner une récolte complète, de sorte que les pertes ne peuvent pas être réparées en une seule saison.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **Coûts de transport et de commerce.** Les perturbations du fret, les fluctuations monétaires et les droits de douane à l'importation alourdissent la facture des torréfacteurs.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Décalage de détail.** Les torréfacteurs achètent souvent à l'avance et utilisent des contrats de couverture, de sorte que les variations du prix des matières premières peuvent mettre des mois à se refléter sur les étagères, dans les deux sens.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **Un répit est-il en vue ?** Cela dépend des récoltes.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: Des récoltes plus importantes dans les pays clés peuvent faire baisser les prix de gros, mais les prix de détail ont tendance à baisser plus lentement qu'ils n'ont augmenté.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: Les acheteurs verront probablement plus de promotions avant de voir des prix affichés plus bas.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## Cacao : maladie, météo et offre concentrée

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: Les prix du chocolat reflètent l'une des chaînes d'approvisionnement les plus concentrées de l'alimentation.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: Une grande partie du cacao mondial provient d'Afrique de l'Ouest, en particulier de la Côte d'Ivoire et du Ghana.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Problèmes de récolte.** Des pluies abondantes, des périodes de sécheresse et des maladies des plantes telles que le virus des turgescences ont réduit les rendements au cours des dernières saisons.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **Arbres vieillissants et marges réduites.** De nombreuses exploitations ont des arbres plus âgés et des fonds limités pour la replantation, ce qui freine la production.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Répercussion sur les produits.** Les fabricants ont réagi par des prix plus élevés, des emballages plus petits ou des changements de recettes. Le cacao n'étant qu'un ingrédient parmi le sucre, les produits laitiers et l'emballage, l'effet sur une barre de chocolat apparaît avec un décalage.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Réaction de la demande.** Lorsque les prix restent élevés, certains acheteurs se tournent vers des produits moins chers ou achètent moins, ce qui peut finir par atténuer la pression sur le marché.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **Un répit est-il en vue ?** Le cacao peut fluctuer fortement à chaque rapport sur les récoltes.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: Une forte reprise de la production ouest-africaine aiderait, mais les analystes préviennent que les prix du chocolat au détail s'ajustent généralement lentement même après la baisse du cacao brut.
