segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## Moyens pratiques pour faire face au quotidien

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **Changer de morceaux.** Le bœuf haché, le paleron et d'autres morceaux moins chers coûtent souvent moins cher que les steaks, et la cuisson lente les rend tendres.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **Mélanger les protéines.** Remplacer le poulet, les œufs, les haricots ou les lentilles dans certains repas peut réduire la facture hebdomadaire.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **Comparer les formats de café.** Les marques de distributeur, les grands paquets ou les grains entiers moulus à la maison peuvent réduire le coût par tasse. Surveillez le prix unitaire plutôt que le prix du paquet.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **Acheter le chocolat en promotion.** Les soldes saisonnières et les marques de distributeur peuvent offrir des économies, et le chocolat à pâtisser peut remplacer certaines recettes.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **Utiliser les prix unitaires.** La réduction de la taille des emballages peut donner l'impression qu'un prix n'a pas changé alors que ce n'est pas le cas.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: Le ralentissement de l'inflation globale ne signifie pas que tous les prix baissent en même temps.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: Le bœuf, le café et le cacao sont soutenus par des cheptels, des récoltes et des coûts commerciaux qui ne peuvent pas être corrigés rapidement.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: Le répit arrivera probablement de manière graduelle, grâce à une meilleure météo, de plus grandes récoltes et des cheptels reconstitués, et il atteindra probablement les rayons des magasins plus tard que les marchés des matières premières.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: D'ici là, des habitudes d'achat flexibles sont l'outil le plus fiable dont disposent les consommateurs.

pt.title: Carne, Café e Cacau: Por Que Alguns Alimentos Básicos Continuam Batendo Recordes de Preço

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: A inflação geral arrefeceu desde o seu pico, mas qualquer pessoa que tenha estado em um corredor de supermercado recentemente sabe que o número principal não conta a história toda.

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: Um punhado de itens do dia a dia, incluindo **carne bovina, café e chocolate**, permaneceu teimosamente caro.

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: Cada um tem sua própria causa e cada um tem uma perspectiva diferente de alívio.

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **Note:** Este artigo é um panorama geral, não um conselho financeiro ou de compras. Os preços variam por região, loja e semana, portanto, verifique os números atuais em fontes oficiais, como o U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics e o USDA.

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## Por que as médias podem esconder grandes diferenças

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: Os índices de preços ao consumidor combinam centenas de mercadorias.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: Quando os custos de energia diminuem ou os preços de carros usados caem, eles podem puxar o número geral para baixo, mesmo enquanto certos alimentos continuam subindo.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: Os alimentos também são excepcionalmente expostos a fatores que ficam fora dos ciclos econômicos normais: clima, biologia animal, doenças de culturas e política comercial.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: É por isso que alguns produtos básicos podem continuar batendo recordes em um ambiente de inflação mais calma.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## Carne Bovina: leva anos para produzir mais gado

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: Os preços da carne bovina são amplamente uma história de **oferta que não pode ser reconstruída rapidamente**.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **Herd size.** O rebanho bovino dos EUA encolheu para alguns de seus níveis mais baixos em décadas. Vários anos de seca em grandes regiões de pastejo levaram os pecuaristas a vender animais mais cedo porque a pastagem e o feno eram escassos ou caros.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **Biology and timing.** Uma novilha mantida para formar o rebanho não está disponível para abate. Leva cerca de dois anos ou mais para que seu bezerro atinja o peso de mercado. A reconstrução, portanto, reduz a oferta de carne bovina antes de aumentá-la.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **Costs along the chain.** Os custos de ração, combustível, mão de obra e processamento afetam o que acaba no balcão de carnes.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **Trade.** Os EUA importam uma quantidade significativa de carne bovina magra usada em produtos moídos. Tarifas, limites de importação e mudanças nos países fornecedores podem aumentar os custos desses cortes.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **Is relief in sight?** Provavelmente não tão cedo.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: Os analistas geralmente esperam que a oferta restrita persista até que os rebanhos se reconstruam, e esse processo pode levar anos.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: Boas chuvas e ração mais barata ajudariam, mas a defasagem está embutida no ciclo do gado.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## Café: uma colheita impulsionada pelo clima em poucos lugares

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: O café é cultivado em um pequeno número de regiões, portanto, problemas em uma delas podem repercutir no mercado global.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **Climate stress.** Secas, calor e chuvas irregulares em grandes produtores como o Brasil e o Vietnã reduziram as safras em algumas temporadas. Arábica, a variedade comum em bebidas especiais, é especialmente sensível à temperatura e à precipitação.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **Slow replanting.** Uma nova árvore de café leva vários anos para dar uma safra completa, portanto, as perdas não podem ser corrigidas em uma única temporada.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Interrupções no frete, flutuações cambiais e tarifas de importação aumentam o que os torrefadores pagam.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Retail lag.** Os torrefadores costumam comprar com antecedência e usar contratos de hedge, de modo que as mudanças no preço da commodity podem levar meses para aparecer nas prateleiras, em ambas as direções.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **Is relief in sight?** Depende das safras.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: Safras maiores em países-chave podem derrubar os preços no atacado, mas os preços no varejo tendem a cair mais devagar do que subiram.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: Os compradores podem ver mais promoções antes de ver preços de etiqueta mais baixos.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## Cacau: doença, clima e oferta concentrada

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: Os preços do chocolate refletem uma das cadeias de suprimentos mais concentradas nos alimentos.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: Uma grande parte do cacau mundial vem da África Ocidental, particularmente da Costa do Marfim e de Gana.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Crop problems.** Chuvas fortes, períodos de seca e doenças de plantas, como o vírus do broto inchado, reduziram os rendimentos nas temporadas recentes.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Pass-through to products.** Os fabricantes responderam com preços mais altos, embalagens menores ou mudanças na receita. Como o cacau é apenas um ingrediente ao lado de açúcar, laticínios e embalagens, o efeito em uma barra de chocolate aparece com atraso.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Demand response.** Quando os preços permanecem altos, alguns compradores trocam por marcas mais baratas ou compram menos, o que pode eventualmente aliviar a pressão sobre o mercado.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **Is relief in sight?** O cacau pode oscilar fortemente com cada relatório de safra.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: Uma recuperação forte na produção da África Ocidental ajudaria, mas os analistas alertam que os preços do chocolate no varejo geralmente se ajustam lentamente mesmo após a queda do cacau bruto.

segments.tr: - **Biaya pengiriman dan perdagangan.** Gangguan pengiriman, fluktuasi mata uang, and tarif impor menambah apa yang dibayar oleh pemanggang.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Jeda ritel.** Pemanggang sering kali membeli di muka dan menggunakan kontrak lindung nilai, sehingga perubahan harga komoditas dapat membutuhkan waktu berbulan-bulan untuk muncul di rak, ke kedua arah.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **Apakah kelegaan sudah di depan mata?** Itu tergantung pada panen.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: Panen yang lebih besar di negara-negara kunci dapat menurunkan harga grosir, tetapi harga eceran cenderung turun lebih lambat daripada saat naik.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: Pembeli mungkin melihat lebih banyak promosi sebelum mereka melihat harga stiker yang lebih rendah.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## Kakao: penyakit, cuaca, dan pasokan yang terkonsentrasi

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: Harga cokelat mencerminkan salah satu rantai pasokan paling terkonsentrasi dalam makanan.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar kakao dunia berasal dari Afrika Barat, terutama Pantai Gading dan Ghana.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Masalah tanaman.** Hujan lebat, mantra kering, dan penyakit tanaman seperti virus pucuk bengkak telah memotong hasil panen dalam beberapa musim terakhir.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **Pohon tua dan margin tipis.** Banyak pertanian memiliki pohon yang lebih tua dan uang terbatas untuk penanaman kembali, yang menahan produksi.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Penerusan ke produk.** Produsen telah merespons dengan harga yang lebih tinggi, kemasan yang lebih kecil, atau perubahan resep. Karena kakao hanya satu bahan di samping gula, produk susu, dan kemasan, efek pada sebatang cokelat muncul dengan penundaan.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Respons permintaan.** Ketika harga tetap tinggi, beberapa pembeli turun kelas atau membeli lebih sedikit, yang pada akhirnya dapat meringankan tekanan pada pasar.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **Apakah kelegaan sudah di depan mata?** Kakao dapat berfluktuasi tajam dengan setiap laporan panen.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: Pemulihan yang kuat dalam output Afrika Barat akan membantu, tetapi analis memperingatkan bahwa harga cokelat eceran biasanya menyesuaikan secara perlahan bahkan setelah kakao mentah turun.

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## Apa kesamaan dari ketiga hal tersebut

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | Barang | Tekanan Utama | Mengapa Kelegaan Lambat |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | Daging Sapi | Kawanan ternak kecil, kekeringan, biaya perdagangan | Membangun kembali kawanan butuh waktu bertahun-tahun |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | Kopi | Cuaca di beberapa wilayah kunci, pengiriman | Pohon baru butuh waktu bertahun-tahun untuk berproduksi |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | Kakao | Penyakit, cuaca, pasokan terkonsentrasi | Harga eceran tertinggal dari komoditas mentah |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: Dalam setiap kasus, masalahnya adalah **pasokan yang merespons secara perlahan**, dikombinasikan dengan biaya yang cenderung diteruskan dengan cepat dan ditarik kembali secara perlahan.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: Ekonom sering menggambarkan ini sebagai kelengketan harga: perusahaan lebih cepat menaikkan harga daripada memotongnya.

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## Cara praktis rumah tangga mengatasi

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **Geser potongan.** Daging giling, chuck, dan potongan lain yang lebih murah sering kali berharga lebih rendah daripada steak, dan memasak perlahan membuatnya empuk.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **Campur protein.** Mengganti ayam, telur, kacang-kacangan, atau lentil dalam beberapa makanan dapat menurunkan tagihan mingguan.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan format kopi.** Merek toko, kantong lebih besar, atau biji utuh yang digiling di rumah dapat mengurangi biaya per cangkir. Perhatikan harga satuan daripada harga paket.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **Beli cokelat saat promosi.** Penjualan musiman dan merek toko dapat menawarkan penghematan, dan cokelat kue dapat menggantikan beberapa resep.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **Gunakan harga satuan.** Ukuran kemasan yang menyusut dapat membuat harga terlihat tidak berubah padahal sebenarnya tidak.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: Mendinginkan inflasi secara keseluruhan tidak berarti setiap harga turun bersamaan.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: Daging sapi, kopi, and kakao ditopang oleh kawanan, panen, and biaya perdagangan yang tidak dapat diperbaiki dengan cepat.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: Kelegaan kemungkinan besar akan datang secara bertahap, melalui cuaca yang lebih baik, tanaman yang lebih besar, dan kawanan yang dibangun kembali, dan itu mungkin akan mencapai rak toko kemudian daripada mencapai pasar komoditas.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: Hingga saat itu, kebiasaan belanja yang fleksibel adalah alat paling andal yang dimiliki konsumen.

ja.title: 牛肉、コーヒー、カカオ：なぜ一部の食料品がいまだに価格の最高値を更新し続けているのか

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: 全体のインフレ率はピークから落ち着いてきたが、最近食料品売場に立った人なら誰でも、見出しの数値がすべてを物語っているわけではないことを知っている。

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: **牛肉、コーヒー、チョコレート**など、いくつかの日常的な品目は、依然として頑なに高価格を維持している。

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: それぞれに固有の原因があり、緩和の見通しについてもそれぞれ異なっている。

segments.src: > **Note:** This article is general background, not financial or purchasing advice. Prices vary by region, store and week, so check current figures from official sources such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the USDA.
segments.tr: > **注意:** この記事は一般的な背景情報であり、財務や購買のアドバイスではありません。価格は地域、店舗、週によって異なるため、米国労働統計局（BLS）やUSDA（米国農務省）などの公式情報源から現在の数値を確認してください。

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## 平均値が大きな違いを隠してしまう理由

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: 消費者物価指数は数百の財を統合している。

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: エネルギーコストが和らいだり中古車価格が下落したりすると、特定の食品が上昇し続けている最中であっても、全体の数値を押し下げる要因になり得る。

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: また、食料は通常の景気循環の外側にある要因（天候、動物の生物学的特性、作物病害、貿易政策など）に異常に影響されやすい。

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: それが、より穏やかなインフレ環境の中でも、少数の定番品が価格記録を更新し続ける理由である。

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## 牛肉：より多くの牛を育てるには何年もかかる

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: 牛肉の価格は、主に**急速に再構築できない供給**に関する物語である。

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **群れの規模。** 米国の肉牛の群れは、ここ数十年で最低水準まで縮小している。主要な放牧地における数年間の干ばつにより、牧草や干し草が不足または高価になったため、牧場主は動物を早期に売却せざるを得なくなった。

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **生物学的特性とタイミング。** 群れを増やすために残された雌牛は、と畜に回すことができない。その後、その子牛が市場出荷体重に達するまでに約2年以上かかる。したがって、群れの再構築は、供給を増やす前にまず牛肉の供給を減少させる。

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **サプライチェーン全体にわたるコスト。** 飼料、燃料、労働力、加工コストのすべてが、最終的に肉売り場に並ぶものに影響を与える。

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **貿易。** 米国はひき肉製品に使用される赤身肉を相当量輸入している。関税、輸入制限、供給国の変化により、それらの部位のコストが上昇する可能性がある。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **救済の兆しはあるか？** おそらく当分はない。

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: アナリストらは一般的に、群れが再構築されるまで供給のひっ迫が続くと予想しており、そのプロセスには何年もかかる可能性がある。

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: 恵みの雨や安価な飼料は助けになるだろうが、タイムラグが牛の循環サイクルに組み込まれている。

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## コーヒー：少数の地域における天候依存型の作物

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: コーヒーは少数の地域で栽培されているため、そのうちの1つでのトラブルが世界市場全体に波及する可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **気候のストレス。** ブラジルやベトナムなどの主要生産国における干ばつ、猛暑、不規則な雨は、一部のシーズンで収穫量を減少させている。特製ドリンクに一般的に使用される品種であるアラビカ種は、特に気温と降雨量に敏感である。

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **遅い植え替え。** 新しいコーヒーの木が全収穫量を実らせるには数年かかるため、不作を1シーズンで修正することはできない。

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **輸送および貿易コスト。** 輸送の混乱、通貨の変動、輸入関税が、焙煎業者の支払額をさらに増加させる。

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **小売のタイムラグ。** 焙煎業者はしばしば先物買いやヘッジ契約を利用するため、コモディティ価格の変化が店頭に現れるまでに、双方の方向において数か月かかることがある。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **救済の兆しはあるか？** それは収穫量次第である。

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: 主要国での豊作は卸売価格を押し下げる可能性があるが、小売価格は上昇したときよりもゆっくりと下がる傾向がある。

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: 買い物客は、値札の価格が下がる前に、より多くのプロモーションを目にするかもしれない。

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## カカオ：病気、天候、および集中した供給

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: チョコレートの価格は、食品の中で最も集中したサプライチェーンの1つを反映している。

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: 世界のカカオの大部分は西アフリカ、特にコートジボワールとガーナから供給されている。

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **作物の問題。** 大雨、乾燥期、そしてシュウレンシュートウイルスなどの植物の病気が、近年のシーズンの収穫量を減少させている。

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **老朽化した木と薄い利益率。** 多くの農場では古い木が多く、植え替えのための資金が限られているため、生産が抑制されている。

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **製品への転嫁。** メーカーは価格引き上げ、容量の削減、またはレシピの変更で対応してきた。カカオは砂糖、乳製品、パッケージと並ぶひとつの原料に過ぎないため、板チョコへの影響にはタイムラグが生じる。

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **需要の反応。** 価格が高止まりすると、一部の買い手はより安価な代替品に切り替えたり購入量を減らしたりするため、最終的に市場への圧力が緩和されることがある。

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **救済の兆しはあるか？** カカオは収穫報告ごとに大きく変動する可能性がある。

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: 西アフリカの生産量の力強い回復は助けになるだろうが、生のカカオが下落した後でも、チョコレートの小売価格は通常ゆっくりとしか調整されないとアナリストは警告している。

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## 3つに共通すること

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | 品目 | 主な圧力 | 緩和が遅い理由 |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | 牛肉 | 小さな肉牛の群れ、干ばつ、貿易コスト | 群れの再構築には何年もかかる |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | コーヒー | 少数の主要地域の天候、輸送 | 新しい木が生産できるようになるには何年も必要 |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | カカオ | 病気、天候、集中した供給 | 小売価格が生のコモディティから遅れる |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: いずれの場合も、問題は**反応が遅い供給**であり、それに迅速に転嫁されゆっくりとしか引き下げられないコストが組み合わさっていることである。

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: 経済学者はこれを価格の硬直性と表現することが多く、企業は価格を引き下げるよりも引き上げる方が早い。

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## 家計が対処するための実用的な方法

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **部位の切り替え。** ひき肉、チャック、その他の安価な部位はステーキよりも安価であることが多く、じっくり調理することで柔らかくなる。

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **タンパク質の混合。** 一部の食事で鶏肉、卵、豆類、レンズ豆に置き換えることで、週の請求額を抑えることができる。

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **コーヒーの形態の比較。** プライベートブランド、大容量の袋、または自宅で挽くホールビーンは、1杯あたりのコストを削減できる。パッケージの価格ではなく、単位あたりの価格に注目する。

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **プロモーション時にチョコレートを購入する。** 季節のセールやストアブランドは節約につながり、製菓用チョコレートは一部のレシピの代わりになる。

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **単位価格を使用する。** パッケージサイズの縮小により、実際には変わっていない価格が変更されていないように見せかけられることがある。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: 全体のインフレ率が冷却化しても、すべての価格が一緒に下がるわけではない。

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: 牛肉、コーヒー、カカオは、急速に修正できない群れ、収穫量、貿易コストによって支えられている。

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: 救済は、より良い天候、より豊富な作物、そして再構築された群れを通じて徐々に訪れる可能性が高く、コモディティ市場に届くよりも遅れて店頭の棚に届くだろう。

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: それまでの間、柔軟な買い物習慣が消費者の持つ最も信頼できるツールである。

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## Warum Durchschnitte große Unterschiede verbergen können

segments.src: Consumer price indexes blend hundreds of goods.
segments.tr: Verbraucherpreisindizes fassen Hunderte von Waren zusammen.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: Wenn die Energiekosten sinken oder die Preise für Gebrauchtwagen fallen, können sie den Gesamtwert nach unten ziehen, selbst während bestimmte Lebensmittel weiter steigen.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: Lebensmittel sind zudem ungewöhnlich stark Dingen ausgesetzt, die außerhalb normaler Wirtschaftszyklen liegen: Wetter, Tierbiologie, Pflanzenkrankheiten und Handelspolitik.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: Deshalb können einige Grundnahrungsmittel in einem ruhigeren Inflationsumfeld weiterhin Rekorde aufstellen.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## Rindfleisch: Es dauert Jahre, um mehr Rinder zu züchten

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: Die Rindfleischpreise sind größtenteils eine Geschichte über **Angebot, das nicht schnell wieder aufgebaut werden kann**.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **Herdengröße.** Die US-Rinderherde ist auf einige ihrer niedrigsten Stände seit Jahrzehnten geschrumpft. Mehrjährige Dürreperioden in wichtigen Weideregionen veranlassten Viehzüchter dazu, Tiere frühzeitig zu verkaufen, da Weideland und Heu knapp oder teuer waren.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **Biologie und Timing.** Eine zurückgehaltene Fersen, um die Herde aufzubauen, steht nicht zum Schlachten zur Verfügung. Es dauert dann etwa zwei Jahre oder mehr, bis ihr Kalb das Marktgewicht erreicht. Der Wiederaufbau verringert daher das Rindfleischangebot, bevor er es erhöht.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **Kosten entlang der Kette.** Futter, Treibstoff, Arbeit und Verarbeitungskosten beeinflussen alle, was schließlich in der Fleischtheke landet.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **Handel.** Die USA importieren eine nennenswerte Menge mageren Rindfleischs, das für Hackfleischprodukte verwendet wird. Zölle, Importbeschränkungen und Verschiebungen bei den Lieferländern können die Kosten für diese Teilstücke erhöhen.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **Ist Entlastung in Sicht?** Wahrscheinlich nicht so bald.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: Analysten gehen im Allgemeinen davon aus, dass das knappe Angebot anhält, bis sich die Herden erholen, und dieser Prozess kann Jahre dauern.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: Guter Regen und billigeres Futter würden helfen, aber die Verzögerung ist im Rinderzyklus eingebaut.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## Kaffee: Eine witterungsabhängige Kulturpflanze an wenigen Orten

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: Kaffee wird in einer kleinen Anzahl von Regionen angebaut, so dass Probleme in einer Region den globalen Markt durchschlagen können.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **Klimastress.** Dürren, Hitze und unregelmäßige Regenfälle in großen Produzenten wie Brasilien und Vietnam haben die Ernten in einigen Saisons reduziert. Arabica, die in Spezialgetränken übliche Sorte, ist besonders empfindlich gegenüber Temperatur und Niederschlag.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **Langsames Nachpflanzen.** Ein neuer Kaffeebaum braucht mehrere Jahre, um eine volle Ernte zu tragen, so dass Verluste nicht in einer einzigen Saison behoben werden können.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **Versand- und Handelskosten.** Frachtstörungen, Währungsschwankungen und Importzölle erhöhen das, was Röster zahlen.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Einzelhandelsverzögerung.** Röster kaufen oft im Voraus ein und nutzen Absicherungsverträge, so dass Änderungen des Rohstoffpreises Monate brauchen können, um in den Regalen aufzutauchen, und zwar in beide Richtungen.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **Ist Entlastung in Sicht?** Das hängt von den Ernten ab.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: Größere Ernten in wichtigen Ländern können die Großhandelspreise senken, aber die Einzelhandelspreise neigen dazu, langsamer zu fallen, als sie gestiegen sind.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: Käufer sehen möglicherweise mehr Aktionen, bevor sie niedrigere Etikettenpreise sehen.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## Kakao: Krankheit, Wetter und konzentriertes Angebot

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: Schokoladenpreise spiegeln eine der am stärksten konzentrierten Lieferketten in der Lebensmittelindustrie wider.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: Ein großer Teil des weltweiten Kakaos stammt aus Westafrika, insbesondere der Elfenbeinküste und Ghana.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Ernteprobleme.** Starker Regen, Trockenperioden und Pflanzenkrankheiten wie das Swollen-Shoot-Virus haben die Erträge in den letzten Saisons gesenkt.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **Alternde Bäume und dünne Margen.** Viele Farmen haben ältere Bäume und begrenztes Geld für das Nachpflanzen, was die Produktion hemmt.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Weitergabe an Produkte.** Hersteller haben mit höheren Preisen, kleineren Packungen oder Rezepturänderungen reagiert. Da Kakao nur eine Zutat neben Zucker, Milchprodukten und Verpackung ist, zeigt sich die Auswirkung auf einen Schokoriegel mit Verzögerung.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Nachfrage-Reaktion.** Wenn die Preise hoch bleiben, weichen einige Käufer auf günstigere Alternativen aus oder kaufen weniger, was den Druck auf den Markt schließlich lindern kann.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **Ist Entlastung in Sicht?** Kakao kann bei jedem Ernterichtwert stark schwanken.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: Eine starke Erholung der westafrikanischen Produktion würde helfen, aber Analysten warnen, dass die Einzelhandelspreise für Schokolade selbst nach dem Sinken des Rohkakaos normalerweise langsam anpassen.

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## Was die drei gemeinsam haben

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | Rindfleisch | Kleine Rinderherde, Dürre, Handelskosten | Wiederaufbau der Herden dauert Jahre |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | Kaffee | Wetter in wenigen Schlüsselregionen, Versand | Neue Bäume brauchen Jahre zum Produzieren |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | Kakao | Krankheit, Wetter, konzentriertes Angebot | Einzelhandelspreise hinken dem Rohstoff hinterher |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: In jedem Fall ist das Problem ein **Angebot, das langsam reagiert**, kombiniert mit Kosten, die tendenziell schnell weitergegeben und langsam zurückgenommen werden.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: Ökonomen beschreiben dies oft als Preisrigidität: Unternehmen erhöhen Preise schneller, als sie sie senken.

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## Praktische Wege, wie Haushalte zurechtkommen

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **Teilstücke wechseln.** Hackfleisch, Rinderbug und andere günstigere Teilstücke kosten oft weniger als Steaks, und langes Kochen macht sie zart.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **Proteine mischen.** Das Ersetzen von Hühnchen, Eiern, Bohnen oder Linsen in einigen Mahlzeiten kann die wöchentliche Rechnung senken.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **Kaffeeformate vergleichen.** Handelsmarken, größere Packungen oder zu Hause gemahlene ganze Bohnen können die Kosten pro Tasse senken. Achten Sie auf den Grundpreis statt auf den Packungspreis.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **Schokolade im Angebot kaufen.** Saisonale Verkäufe und Handelsmarken können Einsparungen bieten, und Backschokolade kann einige Rezepte ersetzen.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **Grundpreise nutzen.** Schrumpfende Packungsgrößen können einen Preis unverändert erscheinen lassen, wenn er es nicht ist.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: Eine Abkühlung der Gesamtinflation bedeutet nicht, dass jeder Preis gemeinsam fällt.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: Rindfleisch, Kaffee und Kakao werden durch Herden, Ernten und Handelskosten gestützt, die nicht schnell behoben werden können.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: Entlastung wird am ehesten schrittweise ankommen, durch besseres Wetter, größere Ernten und wiederaufgebaute Herden, und sie wird die Supermarktregale wahrscheinlich später erreichen als die Rohstoffmärkte.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: Bis dahin sind flexible Einkaufsgewohnheiten das zuverlässigste Werkzeug, das Verbraucher haben.

vi.title: Thịt bò, Cà phê và Ca cao: Tại sao một số mặt hàng tạp hóa thiết yếu vẫn liên tục lập kỷ lục giá

segments.src: Overall inflation has cooled from its peak, but anyone who has stood in a grocery aisle lately knows the headline number does not tell the whole story.
segments.tr: Lạm phát tổng thể đã hạ nhiệt từ mức đỉnh, nhưng bất kỳ ai đứng trong lối đi của cửa hàng tạp hóa gần đây đều biết rằng con số chung không phản ánh toàn bộ câu chuyện.

segments.src: A handful of everyday items, including **beef, coffee and chocolate**, have stayed stubbornly expensive.
segments.tr: Một số ít mặt hàng thiết yếu hàng ngày, bao gồm **thịt bò, cà phê và sô cô la**, vẫn giữ mức giá cao một cách cứng đầu.

segments.src: Each has its own cause, and each has a different outlook for relief.
segments.tr: Mỗi mặt hàng có nguyên nhân riêng và có triển vọng giảm giá khác nhau.

segments.src: ## Why averages can hide big differences
segments.tr: ## Tại sao các con số trung bình có thể che giấu sự khác biệt lớn

segments.tr: Chỉ số giá tiêu dùng kết hợp hàng trăm mặt hàng.

segments.src: When energy costs ease or used-car prices fall, they can pull the overall figure down even while certain foods keep climbing.
segments.tr: Khi chi phí năng lượng giảm bớt hoặc giá xe đã qua sử dụng giảm, chúng có thể kéo con số tổng thể xuống ngay cả khi một số loại thực phẩm tiếp tục tăng.

segments.src: Food is also unusually exposed to things that sit outside normal economic cycles: weather, animal biology, crop disease and trade policy.
segments.tr: Thực phẩm cũng đặc biệt dễ bị ảnh hưởng bởi các yếu tố nằm ngoài chu kỳ kinh tế thông thường: thời tiết, sinh học động vật, dịch bệnh cây trồng và chính sách thương mại.

segments.src: That is why a few staples can keep setting records in a calmer inflation environment.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao một số ít mặt hàng thiết yếu vẫn có thể liên tục lập kỷ lục trong một môi trường lạm phát ôn hòa hơn.

segments.src: ## Beef: it takes years to make more cattle
segments.tr: ## Thịt bò: phải mất nhiều năm để tăng đàn gia súc

segments.src: Beef prices are largely a story about **supply that cannot be rebuilt quickly**.
segments.tr: Giá thịt bò phần lớn là câu chuyện về ** nguồn cung không thể phục hồi nhanh chóng**.

segments.src: - **Herd size.** The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to some of its lowest levels in decades. Several years of drought across major grazing regions pushed ranchers to sell animals early because pasture and hay were scarce or costly.
segments.tr: - **Quy mô đàn.** Đàn gia súc ở Hoa Kỳ đã thuρ giảm xuống mức thấp nhất trong nhiều thập kỷ. Nhiều năm hạn hán ở các vùng chăn nuôi chính đã thúc đẩy những người chăn nuôi bán động vật sớm vì đồng cỏ và cỏ khô khan hiếm hoặc đắt đỏ.

segments.src: - **Biology and timing.** A heifer kept back to build the herd is not available for slaughter. It then takes roughly two years or more before her calf reaches market weight. Rebuilding therefore reduces beef supply before it increases it.
segments.tr: - **Sinh học và thời điểm.** Một con bò cái hậu bị được giữ lại để gây dựng đàn sẽ không sẵn sàng để giết mổ. Sau đó, phải mất khoảng hai năm trở lên thì bê con của nó mới đạt trọng lượng thương phẩm. Do đó, việc gây dựng lại đàn sẽ làm giảm nguồn cung thịt bò trước khi làm tăng nó lên.

segments.src: - **Costs along the chain.** Feed, fuel, labor and processing costs all affect what ends up in the meat case.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí dọc theo chuỗi.** Thức ăn chăn nuôi, nhiên liệu, nhân công và chi phí chế biến đều ảnh hưởng đến những gì cuối cùng có mặt trong quầy thịt.

segments.src: - **Trade.** The U.S. imports a meaningful amount of lean beef used in ground products. Tariffs, import limits and shifts in supplier countries can raise costs for those cuts.
segments.tr: - **Thương mại.** Hoa Kỳ nhập khẩu một lượng đáng kể thịt bò nạc được sử dụng trong các sản phẩm xay nhỏ. Thuế quan, hạn mức nhập khẩu và sự thay đổi ở các quốc gia cung cấp có thể làm tăng chi phí cho các phần thịt đó.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Probably not soon.
segments.tr: **Liệu có hy vọng giảm giá không?** Có lẽ không sớm đâu.

segments.src: Analysts generally expect tight supplies to persist until herds rebuild, and that process can take years.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích nhìn chung kỳ vọng nguồn cung thắt chặt sẽ tiếp tục cho đến khi đàn gia súc được phục hồi, và quá trình đó có thể mất nhiều năm.

segments.src: Good rains and cheaper feed would help, but the lag is built into the cattle cycle.
segments.tr: Những cơn mưa thuận lợi và thức ăn chăn nuôi rẻ hơn sẽ giúp ích, nhưng độ trễ vốn đã có sẵn trong chu kỳ chăn nuôi.

segments.src: ## Coffee: a weather-driven crop in a few places
segments.tr: ## Cà phê: loại cây trồng phụ thuộc vào thời tiết ở một số ít nơi

segments.src: Coffee is grown in a small number of regions, so trouble in one can ripple through the global market.
segments.tr: Cà phê được trồng ở một số ít khu vực, vì vậy rắc rối ở một nơi có thể lan rộng khắp thị trường toàn cầu.

segments.src: - **Climate stress.** Droughts, heat and irregular rains in major producers such as Brazil and Vietnam have reduced harvests in some seasons. Arabica, the variety common in specialty drinks, is especially sensitive to temperature and rainfall.
segments.tr: - **Căng thẳng khí hậu.** Hạn hán, nắng nóng và mưa thất thường ở các quốc gia sản xuất lớn như Brazil và Việt Nam đã làm giảm sản lượng thu hoạch trong một số mùa vụ. Arabica, giống cà phê phổ biến trong các loại đồ uống đặc sản, đặc biệt nhạy cảm với nhiệt độ và lượng mưa.

segments.src: - **Slow replanting.** A new coffee tree takes several years to bear a full crop, so losses cannot be fixed in a single season.
segments.tr: - **Trồng lại chậm.** Một cây cà phê mới phải mất vài năm mới cho thu hoạch đầy đủ, vì vậy tổn thất không thể được khắc phục chỉ trong một mùa vụ.

segments.src: - **Shipping and trade costs.** Freight disruptions, currency swings and import tariffs add to what roasters pay.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí vận chuyển và thương mại.** Gián đoạn vận chuyển, biến động tiền tệ và thuế nhập khẩu làm tăng thêm chi phí mà các nhà rang xay phải trả.

segments.src: - **Retail lag.** Roasters often buy ahead and use hedging contracts, so changes in the commodity price can take months to show up on shelves, in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Độ trễ bán lẻ.** Các nhà rang xay thường mua trước và sử dụng hợp đồng phòng ngừa rủi ro, vì vậy những thay đổi về giá hàng hóa có thể mất vài tháng mới xuất hiện trên kệ hàng, theo cả hai hướng.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** It depends on harvests.
segments.tr: **Liệu có hy vọng giảm giá không?** Điều đó phụ thuộc vào các vụ thu hoạch.

segments.src: Larger crops in key countries can bring wholesale prices down, but retail prices tend to fall more slowly than they rose.
segments.tr: Sản lượng lớn hơn ở các quốc gia trọng điểm có thể kéo giá bán buôn xuống, nhưng giá bán lẻ có xu hướng giảm chậm hơn so với khi chúng tăng lên.

segments.src: Shoppers may see more promotions before they see lower sticker prices.
segments.tr: Người mua sắm có thể thấy nhiều chương trình khuyến mại hơn trước khi họ thấy giá niêm yết thấp hơn.

segments.src: ## Cocoa: disease, weather and concentrated supply
segments.tr: ## Ca cao: dịch bệnh, thời tiết và nguồn cung tập trung

segments.src: Chocolate prices reflect one of the most concentrated supply chains in food.
segments.tr: Giá sô cô la phản ánh một trong những chuỗi cung ứng tập trung nhất trong ngành thực phẩm.

segments.src: A large share of the world's cocoa comes from West Africa, particularly Ivory Coast and Ghana.
segments.tr: Phần lớn ca cao trên thế giới đến từ Tây Phi, đặc biệt là Bờ Biển Ngà và Ghana.

segments.src: - **Crop problems.** Heavy rain, dry spells and plant diseases such as swollen shoot virus have cut yields in recent seasons.
segments.tr: - **Vấn đề mùa vụ.** Mưa nhiều, thời tiết khô hạn và các bệnh thực vật như virus chồi phồng đã làm giảm năng suất trong các mùa vụ gần đây.

segments.src: - **Aging trees and thin margins.** Many farms have older trees and limited money for replanting, which holds back production.
segments.tr: - **Cây già cỗi và biên lợi nhuận mỏng.** Nhiều trang trại có cây trồng lâu năm và nguồn vốn hạn chế cho việc trồng lại, điều này kìm hãm sản lượng.

segments.src: - **Pass-through to products.** Manufacturers have responded with higher prices, smaller packages or recipe changes. Because cocoa is only one ingredient alongside sugar, dairy and packaging, the effect on a candy bar shows up with a delay.
segments.tr: - **Chuyển dịch sang sản phẩm.** Các nhà sản xuất đã phản ứng bằng cách tăng giá, giảm kích thước bao bì hoặc thay đổi công thức. Do ca cao chỉ là một thành phần cùng với đường, sữa và bao bì, nên tác động lên một thanh kẹo xuất hiện với độ trễ.

segments.src: - **Demand response.** When prices stay high, some buyers trade down or buy less, which can eventually ease pressure on the market.
segments.tr: - **Phản ứng của nhu cầu.** Khi giá duy trì ở mức cao, một số người mua chuyển sang sản phẩm thay thế rẻ hơn hoặc mua ít hơn, điều này cuối cùng có thể làm dịu bớt áp lực lên thị trường.

segments.src: **Is relief in sight?** Cocoa can swing sharply with each harvest report.
segments.tr: **Liệu có hy vọng giảm giá không?** Ca cao có thể biến động mạnh theo từng báo cáo thu hoạch.

segments.src: A strong recovery in West African output would help, but analysts caution that retail chocolate prices usually adjust slowly even after raw cocoa falls.
segments.tr: Sự phục hồi mạnh mẽ trong sản lượng ở Tây Phi sẽ giúp ích, nhưng các nhà phân tích cảnh báo rằng giá sô cô la bán lẻ thường điều chỉnh chậm ngay cả sau khi giá ca cao thô giảm.

segments.src: ## What the three have in common
segments.tr: ## Điểm chung của cả ba loại

segments.src: | Item | Main pressure | Why relief is slow |
segments.tr: | Mặt hàng | Áp lực chính | Tại sao việc giảm giá lại chậm |

segments.src: | Beef | Small cattle herd, drought, trade costs | Rebuilding herds takes years |
segments.tr: | Thịt bò | Đàn gia súc nhỏ, hạn hán, chi phí thương mại | Gây dựng lại đàn mất nhiều năm |

segments.src: | Coffee | Weather in a few key regions, shipping | New trees need years to produce |
segments.tr: | Cà phê | Thời tiết ở một số ít khu vực chính, vận chuyển | Cây mới cần nhiều năm để sản xuất |

segments.src: | Cocoa | Disease, weather, concentrated supply | Retail prices lag the raw commodity |
segments.tr: | Ca cao | Dịch bệnh, thời tiết, nguồn cung tập trung | Giá bán lẻ chậm hơn giá hàng hóa thô |

segments.src: In each case, the problem is **supply that responds slowly**, combined with costs that tend to be passed on quickly and rolled back slowly.
segments.tr: Trong mỗi trường hợp, vấn đề là **nguồn cung phản ứng chậm**, kết hợp với các chi phí có xu hướng được chuyển sang nhanh chóng và được thu hồi chậm.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as price stickiness: companies are quicker to raise prices than to cut them.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế thường mô tả đây là tính ì của giá: các công ty tăng giá nhanh hơn là cắt giảm giá.

segments.src: ## Practical ways households cope
segments.tr: ## Những cách thiết thực giúp các hộ gia đình đối phó

segments.src: - **Shift cuts.** Ground beef, chuck and other less expensive cuts often cost less than steaks, and slow cooking makes them tender.
segments.tr: - **Thay đổi phần cắt thịt.** Thịt bò xay, thịt ức và các phần thịt ít đắt tiền hơn thường có giá thấp hơn thịt bít tết, và phương pháp nấu chậm sẽ giúp chúng mềm hơn.

segments.src: - **Mix proteins.** Substituting chicken, eggs, beans or lentils in some meals can lower the weekly bill.
segments.tr: - **Trộn lẫn các nguồn protein.** Thay thế thịt gà, trứng, đậu hoặc đậu lăng trong một số bữa ăn có thể làm giảm hóa đơn hàng tuần.

segments.src: - **Compare coffee formats.** Store brands, larger bags or whole beans ground at home can reduce cost per cup. Watch the unit price rather than the package price.
segments.tr: - **So sánh các định dạng cà phê.** Thương hiệu của cửa hàng, túi lớn hơn hoặc hạt cà phê nguyên hạt được xay tại nhà có thể làm giảm chi phí cho mỗi tách. Hãy xem giá đơn vị thay vì giá trên bao bì.

segments.src: - **Buy chocolate on promotion.** Seasonal sales and store brands can offer savings, and baking chocolate can substitute for some recipes.
segments.tr: - **Mua sô cô la khi có khuyến mại.** Các đợt giảm giá theo mùa và thương hiệu cửa hàng có thể mang lại khoản tiết kiệm, và sô cô la làm bánh có thể thay thế cho một số công thức nấu ăn.

segments.src: - **Use unit prices.** Shrinking package sizes can make a price look unchanged when it is not.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng giá đơn vị.** Kích thước bao bì thu nhỏ lại có thể làm cho giá trông có vẻ không thay đổi trong khi thực tế không phải vậy.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Cooling overall inflation does not mean every price falls together.
segments.tr: Lạm phát tổng thể hạ nhiệt không có nghĩa là mọi giá cả đều giảm cùng nhau.

segments.src: Beef, coffee and cocoa are held up by herds, harvests and trade costs that cannot be fixed quickly.
segments.tr: Thịt bò, cà phê và ca cao được giữ ở mức giá cao là nhờ đàn gia súc, vụ thu hoạch và chi phí thương mại không thể được khắc phục nhanh chóng.

segments.src: Relief is most likely to arrive gradually, through better weather, bigger crops and rebuilt herds, and it will probably reach store shelves later than it reaches commodity markets.
segments.tr: Sự giảm giá nhiều khả năng sẽ đến từ từ, thông qua thời tiết tốt hơn, mùa vụ bội thu hơn và đàn gia súc được gây dựng lại, và nó có thể sẽ đến các kệ hàng bán lẻ muộn hơn so với các thị trường hàng hóa.

segments.src: Until then, flexible shopping habits are the most reliable tool consumers have.
segments.tr: Cho đến lúc đó, thói quen mua sắm linh hoạt là công cụ đáng tin cậy nhất mà người tiêu dùng có.
